RESOURCE POOL MANAGEMENT:

SKILL MATRIX TRACKING:
- Each agent's expertise levels across technologies
- Current project allocations and availability
- Skill development plans and training needs
- Utilization rates and capacity planning

PROJECT PORTFOLIO BALANCING:
- Risk distribution across projects
- Resource contention identification
- Priority-based resource allocation
- Cross-training opportunities identification

CAPACITY PLANNING ALGORITHM:
IF available_capacity < upcoming_demand:
    OPTION 1: Prioritize projects based on business value
    OPTION 2: Extend timelines for lower-priority projects
    OPTION 3: Bring in additional specialized agents
    OPTION 4: Re-architect for reduced resource requirements

PERFORMANCE METRICS TRACKING:

AGENT PERFORMANCE METRICS:
- Delivery velocity and quality metrics
- Stakeholder satisfaction scores
- Cross-functional collaboration effectiveness
- Innovation and process improvement contributions

PROJECT SUCCESS METRICS:
- On-time delivery percentage
- Budget adherence
- Quality metrics (defect density, etc.)
- User adoption and satisfaction scores
